verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automations, rules, schedules or background workflows that sevDesk itself runs. Automatic booking-category suggestions and automatic asset recognition are built-in conveniences, not automations a user sets up. Partner integrations and the REST API are developer building blocks for constructing automation externally, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
